question: The Thal Heavy Water Plant was commissioned in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 1987.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Thal Heavy Water Plant** was commissioned in the year **1987**.
 
• The plant is located at **Thal, Maharashtra**, and plays a crucial role in India's nuclear power program by supplying heavy water (D₂O), which is used as a moderator and coolant in nuclear reactors.
 
• The Thal plant is operated by the **Heavy Water Board (HWB)**, under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India.
 
• Heavy water is essential for the functioning of certain types of nuclear reactors, especially the Pressurized Heavy Water Reactors (PHWRs) used in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Heavy Water**: It is a form of water where the hydrogen atoms (H) are replaced by deuterium (D), a heavier isotope of hydrogen, making the chemical formula D₂O instead of H₂O.
 
• **Importance in Nuclear Reactors**: Heavy water is used as a neutron moderator in nuclear reactors to slow down neutrons so they can sustain a chain reaction in the nuclear fission process.
 
• **Heavy Water Board (HWB)**: The HWB is responsible for the production of heavy water in India, with plants across the country contributing to India’s strategic nuclear program.
 
• **Thal Plant Contributions**: Apart from heavy water production, the Thal Heavy Water Plant has also contributed to the development of technologies related to isotope separation and other nuclear-related processes.
